mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblUserRoute ( user_route_id, user_id, ai_route_id, user_route_title, user_route_days, user_route_region, user_route_startdate, user_route_enddate, user_route_created ) SELECT seqUserRoute.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, ai_route_id, ai_route_title, ai_route_days, ai_route_region, al_route_startdate, al_route_enddate, SYSDATE FROM tblAiRoute WHERE ai_route_id = #{aiRouteId}

INSERT INTO tblUserRouteStop ( user_route_stop_id, user_route_id, user_route_day, user_route_stop_order, user_route_lat, user_route_long, user_route_description, activity_code, duration_category, restaurant_category, transportation_mode ) SELECT seqUserRouteStop.NEXTVAL, #{userRouteId}, ai_route_day, ai_route_stop_order, ai_route_lat, ai_route_long, ai_route_description, activity_code, duration_category, restaurant_category, transportation_mode FROM tblAiRouteStop WHERE ai_route_id = #{aiRouteId}
